quest.title: Big Pudgy Problem!
quest.description: Slimes have suddenly appeared on the Mondstadt docks, and it seems Arthur has become caught up in the commotion...

talks.objective: Go to the docks and see what's going on

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: Thank you! You saved my life.

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: Those slimes came out of nowhere. I didn't think they would show up around these parts... Before I knew what was happening, I was surrounded!

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: Please don't tell my father... He's already been nagging me to stay at home, saying the slimes 'round here are supposed to be getting more hostile recently.

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: With slimes appearing closer to the city, I've been stuck at home for days now. I managed to slip out today without him noticing.

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you check if the coast is clear now? And if not, get rid of the slimes for me?

choices.text: Sure, it won't take me long.

response.speaker: Arthur
response.text: Great! Looks like my father will never have to find out...

choices.text: Sorry, I've got too much on my plate right now.

response.speaker: Arthur
response.text: B—But... I cannot get my father involved... Please, you're the only one who can help me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, what have we here? It looks like dust, but... with elemental traces on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the last of them. But Paimon wonders what they were doing hanging around here?

talks.objective: Use Anemo to blow out the dust
